svg.title: Policy error is higher where training demonstrations disagree about the action
svg.desc: Line chart. Held-out frames binned into deciles of local action disagreement in the training data; policy error relative to each dataset's average rises from 0.76x to 1.35x (average of 6 datasets).

g.text: Open-loop error of a trained policy on held-out demonstrations, grouped by how consistent the training data is nearby.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #98a4b2

g.text: Simulation: 3 DexMimicGen tasks (can sorting, pouring, coffee) × 2 retargetings; 2,996–3,374 frames from 10 held-out demos per dataset.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #98a4b2

g.text: Disagreement = spread of the next action over the 10 nearest training frames (image + joint state). Error = first predicted action, arm + torso.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #98a4b2

g.text: Spearman ρ = 0.25–0.50 per dataset; 0.17–0.37 after controlling for distance to the training data and how much the arm is moving. Correlational.
